name: Linear
summary: This guide describes how to connect your own Linear workspace to an external app using OAuth 2.0, either by manually registering your OAuth app with Linear and supplying its credentials or by using the managed Composio gateway which automates much of the configuration and maintenance. The managed gateway allows for faster setup especially with AI tools, while manual OAuth app setup provides more granular control.
decision: If you want fast integration and automatic credential management, use the managed Composio setup by adding their MCP server URL in your AI tool and authorizing via the browser; otherwise, register your own OAuth application in your Linear workspace settings under API > OAuth applications, setting the proper callback URL for your integration, copying the provided Client ID/Secret, and supplying these details to your application dashboard.

prerequisites.title: Linear account and workspace
prerequisites.body: You need a Linear account and a workspace to register applications or perform integrations.

prerequisites.title: Composio or other integration account (if using managed path)
prerequisites.body: If choosing the managed path, register for a Composio account and ensure you have dashboard access.

steps.title: Create Linear account and workspace
steps.body: Visit https://linear.app, sign up or log in, and create a workspace by assigning it a name and details.

steps.title: Configure OAuth options
steps.body: Optionally make the application Public for installation in other workspaces and ensure the Refresh Tokens option is enabled.
steps.note: Refresh Tokens are enabled by default but can be toggled on if needed.

steps.title: Copy OAuth credentials
steps.body: After saving the OAuth application, copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret for your records and integration setup.

steps.title: Paste credentials into integration
steps.body: In your integration dashboard (Composio, Nango, etc.), paste the Client ID and Secret from Linear and enable 'Use your own developer credentials' if needed.

steps.title: Adjust OAuth scopes (if using Composio)
steps.body: Default Composio scopes include admin, read, write, issues:create, comments:create. Modify these in the Manage Auth Config tab if needed.

steps.title: Connect and authorize
steps.body: Click 'Connect Account' or equivalent in your integration dashboard. Grant consent in the browser to authorize the app and scopes.

human_actions.title: Sign up or log in to Linear
human_actions.body: Access your Linear account and create a workspace as needed.

human_actions.title: Manually register OAuth application
human_actions.body: Navigate to Settings > API > OAuth applications in Linear, and manually create the OAuth app with the requested settings.

human_actions.title: Copy and save credentials
human_actions.body: Copy the app's Client ID and Client Secret after the OAuth app is created.

human_actions.title: Paste credentials into integration dashboard
human_actions.body: Supply the credentials to the integration platform’s auth setup screen (e.g., Composio, Nango, etc.).

human_actions.title: Initiate consent and browser authorization
human_actions.body: Approve requested OAuth scopes and consent to app access in a redirected browser window.
